context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 complete. All REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback fixes verified in code and at runtime. Login, config load, admin panel, and edit mode all working. Backend 11/11 tests green. No regressions detected. Frontend build uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from .env (set to https://carousel-frota-demo.preview.emergentagent.com) — for Render deployment, the env var must be set in Render dashboard; the || '' fallback ensures the app doesn't crash but API calls will go to relative paths which works if frontend and backend are on the same origin.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was undefined in Render build environment (not set as env var in Render dashboard). React replaces process.env.X at build time; if undefined, the expression `${undefined}` produces the string 'undefined', making URLs like '/undefined/api/admin/login'. Fix: added '|| ""' fallback in all 4 files so undefined becomes empty string, resulting in relative paths like '/api/admin/login' which work when frontend and backend share the same origin. Verified fix is present and working.
